messages:
alex: After the postmortem, we should create a compact 'surgery play' and a one-line cue-card for pagers. Goal: reduce decision surface during incidents (who to page, one-liners to run, safe fallback). Who claims which bit?

jen_sre: I can author the cue-card + the short command set (copy/paste). I'll keep it under a single Slack-sized post so oncall can paste to a channel. Due 48h.

maria_pm: I'll define the regression signal and acceptance gates for QA so we don't flip things unnecessarily. Also will write the 1-line CS blurb for any fallback. 72h.

chris_platform: I'll do the admission policy to block risky batch sizes and add a lightweight /internal/health?cache endpoint returning eviction_rate and recent_compiles. Prototype in 5 business days.

alex: Nice. For the cue-card include: 1) verify eviction spike 2) identify offending model 3) apply soft-routing 4) quick rollback recipe 5) page ladder. Keep each to one command where possible.

jen_sre: Draft snippets to include at top of cue-card:
```
# check evictions last 15m
kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --since=15m | grep -i eviction | tail -n 100

# find top restart pods
kubectl get pods -n inference -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount --sort-by='.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount' | tail -n 20

# soft-route model -> fallback
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/admin/routing -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"selector":"model:FOO","policy":"fallback-low-memory"}'
```

chris_platform: Add note: if admission policy blocks a deploy, send auto-ticket and ping the deploy owner. I'll wire that into CI.

alex: Proposed page ladder: oncall -> senior-runtime (10m) -> runtime lead (25m) -> infra-pager (60m). Also require incident doc created within 7 minutes and attach the cue-card output.

maria_pm: Agree. For regressions: create an automated weekly digest that lists models with eviction rate up >0.5% week-over-week and recent deploys. That will feed owners and reduce repeated incidents.

opsbot: Created task <https://tracker.redwood.local/RED-6001|RED-6001> "Cue-card + surgery play + owners" and assigned to jen_sre. Monitor created: `eviction_rate_model > 0.005 over 10m` -> page infra-sre.

jen_sre: I'll also include a tiny 'what to post' template for CS when fallback is enabled: "We detected stability issues and temporarily routed traffic to a compatible variant. Expect minor regressions; we're rolling a fix. ETA: 30-90m."

ian_product: I'll own the customer communication approval and add an FAQ line to the cue-card.

alex: Summary of owners/dates: jen_sre (cue-card + commands) - 48h; chris_platform (admission + health endpoint) - 5d; maria_pm (QA gates + digest) - 72h; ian_product (CS comms) - 72h. We'll check back in 72h on progress.

jen_sre: Acknowledged, will post draft link when ready.

chris_platform: Will open an RFC branch for admission webhook next week.

opsbot: Reminder set for 72 hours: "Cue-card review" (calendar invite sent).
